name: TYPHON
description: Typhon is new, in the spirit of the 5150 III Stealth: all matte black, with a 3D pyramid grid across the front and glossy black stripes criss-crossing it like tape. The stripes only show when the light catches them. GREEN, BLUE and RED pick the three channels, and the light strip and power lamp change to that channel's colour.
